devDesc: Designing, automating and securing enterprise cloud platforms — AWS first, then GCP and Azure.
aboutDescription: Designing, automating, and securing enterprise-scale cloud platforms. Proven record engineering future-proof platforms on AWS and OpenShift, driving Terraform-based IaC at scale, and embedding security and governance into every delivery layer, including secure platforms for generative AI and agentic workloads on AWS Bedrock. Expert at translating strategic goals into actionable engineering outcomes — coaching teams, championing automation-first culture, and aligning platform capability with business objectives across complex enterprise environments.
